en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a sloping road bordered by a steep, grassy embankment on the right and dense trees on the left. A horse-drawn carriage and a few pedestrians travel along the curving street toward a small building at the bottom of the hill, with a river and wooded landscape visible in the distance. Printed captions at the bottom read the city name and the street name.
